Established in 2002, the business is renowned for its web-based pensions administration and management system, IntelliPen. Procentia’s products and solutions help pension schemes and administrators of all types and sizes manage exceptional volumes of data, meet the demand for self-serve technology, and provide meaningful, consumer-like experiences that users expect from modern online financial platforms while minimising the need for administrator intervention and involvement. With offices in the UK and North America, Procentia supports some of the largest pension schemes, insurers and retirement plans across the private and public sectors, including BP, British Airways Pension Scheme, BTPS, Chicago Transit Authority, Legal & General Retirement America, Retirement System City of Detroit, Rolls-Royce, Royal London, and Universities Superannuation Scheme. The Job As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will report to the Group Head of IT and Infrastructure and collaborate with all colleagues in the business, including our development teams to help deliver our products. The role will be joining the platform team focused on our cloud platform environments. The purpose of this role is to ensure our Azure cloud platform is built and supported against best practices. You will work closely with development teams to reduce their cognitive load, enabling them to continually improve our product portfolio. Here's What You'll Be Doing Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement Azure-based solutions that meet business requirements. Create robust and scalable architectures for cloud applications, considering factors such as performance, security, and cost optimisation as well as other none functional requirements. Supporting role in the migration to Azure and modernisation of existing applications. Provision, configure, and manage Azure resources, including virtual machines, storage accounts, app services and networking components. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or Azure Resource Manager templates. Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Azure applications. Automate deployment processes, ensuring efficient and reliable software delivery. Integrate database storage solutions Diagnose and resolve issues related to Azure services, performance bottlenecks, and scalability. Optimise resource utilisation and cost management. Implement best practices for securing Azure resources. Monitor and address security vulnerabilities, compliance requirements, and access controls. Work closely with development teams to understand application requirements and provide Azure-related guidance and solutions. Investigation of problems and determining the best solution Document architectural decisions, configurations, and operational procedures. Key Skills And Experience Understanding cloud computing concepts like Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS). Proficiency in using various Azure services, such as Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Storage, Azure Networking, and Entra ID. Skills in scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, or Bash to automate tasks and manage Azure resources efficiently. Networking: Knowledge of virtual networks, VPNs, load balancers, and other networking components within Azure. Implementing security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, and network security. Familiarity with DevOps tools and practices, such as Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like ARM templates, Terraform, or Ansible. Using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and other tools to monitor performance, diagnose issues, and ensure the reliability of Azure services. Experience with Azure Managed SQL Instance Database, Cosmos DB, and other database services for managing and optimising data storage. Lets Talk About What's In It For You... 25 days holiday (plus public holidays) increasing with length of service up to a maximum of 28 days, with carry over of up to 1 week Buying and Selling holiday (up to 1 week) Volunteer day 5% Employer contribution pension Life Assurance Private Medical Insurance Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Health care cash plan Tusker – Electric Car Leasing scheme Don’t meet every requirement? We know that some candidates, particularly women, disabled people, LGBTQ+ individuals, neurodivergent people, and those from ethnic minority backgrounds, may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. At Procentia, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If this role excites you but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be a great fit for this role or another opportunity within our team.

review_candidates.title: Analista de Monitoramento NOC N1 | Presencial -São Paulo/SP
review_candidates.description: Estamos buscando profissionais para compor uma nova operação de NOC (Network Operations Center) dedicada ao monitoramento da infraestrutura de TI de um cliente do segmento financeiro. Buscamos profissionais com experiência em monitoramento e boa base técnica de infraestrutura, capazes de acompanhar ambientes críticos, identificar e analisar eventos e alertas, realizar o primeiro diagnóstico, executar procedimentos de primeiro combate, registrar evidências e realizar o escalonamento qualificado para os times especialistas quando necessário. A atuação exige disciplina operacional, capacidade analítica, senso de urgência e atenção aos impactos que indisponibilidades ou degradações de serviços de TI podem causar ao negócio. Responsabilidades e atribuições Monitorar continuamente a disponibilidade, performance, logs, métricas, eventos e alertas dos ambientes de infraestrutura e serviços de TI. Identificar, analisar e tratar eventos e alertas de acordo com procedimentos operacionais previamente estabelecidos. Realizar investigação inicial e primeiro diagnóstico de incidentes, buscando identificar sintomas, abrangência, criticidade e possíveis causas. Executar procedimentos de primeiro combate e ações previamente autorizadas para restabelecimento dos serviços. Produzir e registrar evidências técnicas que apoiem a análise crítica dos incidentes e o trabalho dos níveis superiores de suporte. Registrar, classificar, priorizar e acompanhar incidentes e requisições nas ferramentas de ITSM. Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos tickets, desde sua abertura até o encerramento. Realizar acionamentos e escalonamentos para equipes N2, N3, fornecedores e demais grupos solucionadores, conforme procedimentos e matrizes de escalonamento. Garantir que os escalonamentos sejam realizados com informações técnicas, evidências e contexto suficientes para continuidade do atendimento. Acompanhar incidentes críticos e indisponibilidades, mantendo comunicação constante com liderança e equipes envolvidas. Executar procedimentos operacionais, checklists, validações e rotinas periódicas do NOC. Apoiar a identificação de eventos recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no monitoramento. Contribuir para atualização e melhoria contínua de procedimentos, bases de conhecimento e documentação operacional. Trabalhar de forma integrada com as equipes de Infraestrutura, Redes, Sistemas, Telecom, Segurança, Operações e demais áreas de sustentação. Atuar de forma preventiva e preditiva na identificação de riscos relacionados à disponibilidade e performance dos serviços monitorados. Cumprir rigorosamente os processos, procedimentos, políticas de segurança e controles estabelecidos para o ambiente do cliente. Requisitos e qualificações Formação acadêmica Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Tecnologia da Informação, Redes de Computadores, Sistemas de Informação, Formação técnica em Redes, Infraestrutura ou áreas relacionadas poderá ser considerada mediante experiência profissional compatível. Experiência profissional Experiência anterior em NOC, Service Desk técnico, operações de TI, infraestrutura, monitoramento ou sustentação de ambientes de TI. Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes críticos e tratamento de eventos e incidentes. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, observabilidade e/ou ITSM. Vivência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade será considerada um diferencial. Conhecimentos técnicos Conhecimentos de infraestrutura de TI e seus principais componentes. Conhecimentos de sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux. Conhecimentos de redes LAN/WAN e conceitos básicos de topologia de redes. Conhecimentos de TCP/IP e protocolos como DNS, DHCP, ICMP, SNMP, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS e FTP/SFTP. Conhecimentos básicos sobre switches, routers, links, interfaces, servidores, serviços e recursos de infraestrutura. Conhecimentos de monitoramento de disponibilidade, capacidade e performance. Conhecimentos de métricas, eventos, alertas e logs. Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, preferencialmente Zabbix, Grafana, Elastic, Dynatrace ou tecnologias similares. Conhecimentos sobre gerenciamento de incidentes e escalonamento. Conhecimentos de ferramentas de ITSM e gestão do ciclo de vida de tickets. Capacidade de interpretar dashboards, alarmes, logs e informações técnicas para realização do diagnóstico inicial. Capacidade de documentar ocorrências, procedimentos e evidências técnicas de forma clara e objetiva. Certificações e capacitações desejáveis ITIL 4 Foundation. Zabbix Certified Specialist, Zabbix User ou capacitação equivalente em fundamentos de Zabbix. Certificações ou cursos de fundamentos de Redes / TCP-IP. Certificações ou cursos de fundamentos de Linux. Certificações ou capacitações em Grafana, Elastic, Dynatrace ou outras plataformas de monitoramento e observabilidade. Certificações ou treinamentos relacionados a infraestrutura, cloud, redes ou operações de TI serão considerados diferenciais. Diferenciais Experiência anterior em operações de TI ou NOC de ambientes do mercado financeiro, bancário, meios de pagamento ou outros ambientes de missão crítica. Conhecimento sobre a criticidade e os impactos da indisponibilidade de serviços de TI para operações financeiras. Vivência em operações 24x7. Experiência com gestão e tratamento de incidentes críticos. Conhecimento de conceitos de observabilidade e correlação de eventos. Conhecimentos básicos de automação aplicada a operações de TI. Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação, procedimentos e bases de conhecimento. About The Company A Solutis é Digital! Somos apaixonados por tecnologia e esse valor está presente em nossas ações e proposta de trabalho. Ambiente descontraído e criativo, horário flexível, possibilidade de trabalho home office, eventos e programas internos com games... Isso faz parte do nosso dia-a-dia. Engajamento, busca intensa por conhecimento, empatia e criatividade são a nossa receita para cultivar e colher, sempre, o melhor resultado tecnológico. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities. Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions. Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs. Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums. Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization. Operational Excellence Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported. Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance. Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices. Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc). Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively. People Leadership Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization. Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors. Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function. Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions. Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders. Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues. Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership. Engineering Segments Engagement Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity. Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points. Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction. Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs. Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery. Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms. Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery. Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models. Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.
